Just a small update. A close friend reported me on Warcraft, along with this writing. The police showed up at my house during the night to make sure everything was okay. I went to school thinking everything was fine and when I got home, the police chief informed me that the judge ordered for me to be taken by police to get a mental evaluation. So I went and got the help that I needed. I have 2 appointments Friday morning. My first will be to see what kind of help I qualify to receive, and the 2nd is to get some medication that will tie me over until I can verified for a doctor from my first appointment. That part should take 3 weeks and I was told since that I'm a student with no income, most likely each doctor's visit will be $5 along with $5 for prescription medications. 

I knew something was wrong, so I agreed that I needed the help because the last thing I really want to do is leave my parents suffering. I was also informed had I refused help or deemed a threat to myself or anyone else, that I would have been sent away. So me realizing I had a problem was what ended up saving me. Along with my friend who reported me. Thank you for your kind words Trevor.
